title: Linux Kernel Security Flaws: CISA Warns of Active Exploitation Evidence indicates the vulnerabilities are already being exploited.
content_md:
Linux-Kernel-Sicherheitslücken: CISA warnt vor aktiver Ausnutzung Es liegen Hinweise vor, dass die Schwachstellen bereits ausgenutzt werden.

via Mastodon https://www.all-about-security.de/linux-kernel-sicherheitsluecken-cisa-warnt-vor-aktiver-ausnutzung/

CVE-2026-53266.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation. Red Hat advisory updated Sep 19 02:00 UTC.

CVE-2025-39964.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation in af_alg socket.

CVE-2025-39682.evidence: CISA KEV entry added Sep 19 with confirmed active exploitation in TLS rx_list handling.
